analysis.investment_thesis: Greaves Cotton is a legacy engine business in a painful EV transition that has destroyed capital — ROE of 4.1%, operating margins of 3.9%, and negative free cash flow in 4 of the last 5 years make this uninvestable at 34.6x P/E. The business model is fundamentally disrupted and is not yet proven in its new avatar.
key_strengths: Low Debt/Equity of 0.12 — balance sheet not yet overleveraged despite EV investment
Promoter holding stable at 55.8% — skin in the game
Revenue recovering to INR 2,918 Cr in FY25, showing some operational resilience after FY21 collapse
key_risks: Persistently negative OCF — only 1 of last 5 years positive; FCF negative every year since FY22, including -225 Cr in FY24
Catastrophic capital destruction — net losses in FY21, FY22, FY24, and near-zero FY25; cumulative losses wiped reserves from 1,540 Cr (FY23) to 1,329 Cr (FY25)
Operating margins collapsed from 12.6% (FY19) to 3.9% (FY25) — no pricing power in engines, EV segment loss-making
red_flags: Net profit -367 Cr in FY24 — likely large EV impairments hidden in 'Other Income' line (-270 Cr in FY24)
Finance costs growing at 36.1% CAGR — borrowings jumped from 28 Cr (FY23) to 185 Cr (FY25), trend worsening
P/E of 34.6x on distorted, near-zero earnings is a value trap — real earnings power is negligible
ROCE of 5.13% is below cost of capital — this business is destroying shareholder wealth
analysis.detailed_analysis:
Greaves Cotton is a 165-year-old company caught between two eras — its traditional diesel/petrol engine business is structurally declining, and its EV bet (Ampere, ELE brands) has consumed hundreds of crores without producing sustained profits. Operating income has fallen from INR 272 Cr (FY19) to INR 137 Cr (FY25) despite revenue growing — a clear sign of margin compression and poor operating leverage. The company earned INR 201 Cr net profit in FY16 and is earning near-zero in FY25, with three loss years in between. For a value investor like me who demands consistent earnings and ROE above 15%, this is simply not a business I can understand or trust.

The cash flow picture is the most damning — a business that cannot generate operating cash flow is not a business, it is a project. With OCF positive in only 1 of the last 5 years and cumulative FCF of roughly -550 Cr since FY22, the company is burning investor capital while management executes an uncertain strategic pivot. At 34.6x P/E on distorted earnings and 2.67x book, the market is pricing in an EV success story that has not materialised. I do not speculate on turnarounds in capital-heavy industries. Avoid.
